portInfo.description: Administración Portuaria Integral de Baja California Sur (API BCS) describes Puerto Pichilingue inside Bahía de La Paz on the Gulf of California / Sea of Cortés, about 17 km from the city of La Paz, with ferry/commercial zones and reception of megacruise ships whose passengers are transferred to La Paz tourist sites. Technical tables list Muelle de Usos Múltiples No. 2 y Cruceros at 200 m length, 21 m width, height 3.20 m, depth -10.50 m and draft -9.15 m referenced to NBMI. API BCS offices: Km. 17 Carretera a Pichilingue, Puerto Comercial, La Paz, B.C.S., C.P. 23010; +52 (612) 123-6500; apibcs@apibcs.com.mx. Ferry ramps and other multipurpose berths on the same page are cargo/ferry facilities — not assumed as cruise passenger doors.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: City. ~17 km road transfer to La Paz. Independent taxis/coaches typical; no timed shuttle schedule verified on the API page. Return. Build traffic + pier security time — this is not a walk-back harbour.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: La Paz Malecón — ~120 min in town after transfer.
Espíritu Santo boat day — long call only with sea-state and ≥120 min return buffer.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Budget the 17 km each way before saying yes to a far snorkel — Pichilingue is not the Malecón.
